requestChanges.title: Request changes (bounce back)
requestChanges.help: Leave issue-level review feedback (why it did not pass / pass criteria / acceptance gap) and send the card back to the implement lane. The agent continues on its existing changes with both your issue comments and the unresolved line-level diff comments injected, then returns here with a change summary.
requestChanges.placeholder: Why it did not pass, the pass criteria, and the acceptance gap…
requestChanges.done: Sent back to the implement lane for rework

reopen.title: Re-review (re-open this done issue)
reopen.help: This issue is already done. Leave review feedback and re-open it back into the implement lane — the agent picks it up again with your issue comments and the unresolved diff comments injected, then returns for review.
reopen.done: Re-opened into the implement lane for rework

goalCondition.title: Autohost completion criterion (optional)
goalCondition.hint: Leave empty to fall back to sentinel-only stop
goalCondition.help: Autohost uses this criterion as the LLM judge's reference when it's about to stop the current round. e.g. "All unit tests pass" or "PR is merge-ready".
goalCondition.suggestFailed: Failed to generate suggestion, please try again
goalCondition.suggestCliUnavailable: claude CLI not available; AI suggestion disabled
goalCondition.suggestRateLimited: Too many AI suggest requests; please wait a moment
